name: onmyoji-studio
description: Standalone desktop workflow editor and runtime for oooonmyoji

scripts.test: npm run build:electron && npm run build:renderer-tests && node --test tests/*.test.cjs
scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k -s first "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env ONMYOJI_DESKTOP_DEV_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: node scripts/build-light-palette.cjs && npm run typecheck && npm run build:electron && vite build
